title: Reasoning Inconsistencies and How to Mitigate Them in Deep Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Natural Language Inference (NLI) models using adversarially generated, semantics-preserving surface-form variations to measure the models' reliance on shallow heuristics and spurious correlations rather than true logical comprehension.

Measuring inter-topic and per-topic label imbalances in multi-domain stance detection datasets, and evaluating how models generalize across different topics when trained with topic-guided diversity sampling and contrastive learning.

Synthesizing a question-answering dataset for a low-resource language (Armenian) using parallel data mining, and benchmarking state-of-the-art large language models to evaluate performance and reasoning disparities compared to high-resource languages.
